# Edi Javier — Software Engineer

> Edi Javier is a London-based Software Engineer who helps founders and small businesses build websites, web apps, and AI-powered products that remove friction, save time, and accelerate growth.

## About

Edi Javier is a software engineer with 4+ years of experience shipping digital products. He works directly with founders, startups, and growing businesses — from MVPs to scalable platforms. He has shipped 10+ client projects across industries including fintech, healthcare, social platforms, and professional services.

## Services

- **Website Development**: Custom websites with SEO-friendly structure, fast load times, and mobile-first design.
- **Software & Web Apps**: Custom web and mobile applications built to replace manual processes and scale with the business.
- **Maintenance & Support**: 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patches, and ongoing improvements after launch.
- **Ongoing Updates**: New features, design improvements, and compatibility upgrades.
- **AI Integration**: Chatbots, smart search, automated workflows, and data insights built into products.

## Notable Projects

- **Superfanbase** (superfanbase.com): Fan engagement platform — full product strategy, UX design, and end-to-end development.
- **Tokunize**: Fintech platform for asset tokenization — rebuilt from MVP to production-ready system deployed on AWS.
- **Togethr Social** (togethrsocial.com): Social MVP built for investor-ready delivery.
- **AC Services**: Corporate services website for London-based company.
- **VC Clinic**: Healthcare clinic website with appointment booking system.
- **Jesus Antonio**: Personal trainer platform with booking, scheduling, and client management.

## Technology

Specialises in: Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Google Cloud, Tailwind CSS, AI integrations.
